name: arXiv API
summary: Search and fetch metadata for arXiv preprints in physics, maths, computer science and more via an Atom feed API.
description: The arXiv API returns Atom 1.0 feeds of paper metadata: title, abstract, authors, categories, submission and update dates, journal reference, DOI and PDF links. Queries use field prefixes (ti, au, abs, cat, all) with boolean operators and date ranges, or an id_list to fetch specific papers. Metadata is released under CC0.

rate_limit.summary: Terms: no more than one request every three seconds and a single connection at a time, applied across all machines you use.

endpoints.summary: Search papers or fetch by id as an Atom feed

license.name: Metadata: CC0 1.0; full texts have per-paper licenses

agent_notes: Query syntax: search_query=cat:cs.LG+AND+ti:attention, sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending. Fetch one paper with id_list=1706.03762. Page with start and max_results (docs: slices of at most 2000, up to 30000 total). Ids in entries carry a version suffix (v1). For whole-corpus work use bulk metadata, not the API.
caveats: Responses are Atom XML only; no JSON.
No CORS header was sent on a request with an Origin header.
